role: An underwater bubble that rises and dies on leaving water.
scope_reason: In scope like the other particle classes: 'bubble' spawns when an entity enters water (Entity.java:1131), while drowning (EntityLivingBase.java:301) and behind throwables, arrows, eyes and fireballs in water; RenderGlobal builds EntityBubbleFX for it at the All and Decreased particle settings, and each construction spends the client's entity id, seeder and Math.random draws.

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: PLIVE_BUBBLE: up 0.002, x0.85, dead out of water or past its age

notes: No behavior is ported. The scene renderer csrc/engine/raster_particles.c draws whatever class names the recorded state dump lists (base quads or icon quads), so a dump containing this class would render, but nothing constructs or ticks it natively. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). fx_client: the player's splash into water (Entity.handleWaterMovement, 39 bubbles). lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: proven by the rendertick scene fx_client (seed 1, --particles 0, 143 ticks, 3,923 FX compared field by field against the oracle's dump, test_rendertick); it fails with the class changed (a negative control of 80 mismatches).
